import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    n = len(s)
    sum_count = 1
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        if s[i] == s[i-1]:
            sum_count += 1
        else:
            if sum_count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            sum_count = 1
        if i == n-1:
            if sum_count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
